# Open Research {-}

The full analysis pipeline, comprising the `targets` workflow, the reusable R functions (`src/R/`),
the study-parameter configuration (`config/`), and the scripts that generate every figure and
table, is openly available at <https://github.com/frzambra/dam_drought_effectiveness> and archived
on Zenodo [@zambrano_dam_2026]. That archive also holds the reservoir storage records, the derived
result tables, the standardized drought indices computed for this study, and the matched-set
metadata, and is the citable version of record for both the software and the data generated here.
All analyses run in R, using `WeightIt`/`cobalt` for balancing and diagnostics, `fixest` for
fixed-effects regression, and `sf`/`terra`/`exactextractr` for the spatial extractions; the pinned
R environment (`renv.lock`) reproduces the package versions used. Every result in the manuscript
corresponds to a named pipeline target, so the analyses can be regenerated with a single
`targets::tar_make()`.

The third-party input datasets are publicly available from their providers:

- **Precipitation and temperature.** Climate Hazards Group Infrared Precipitation with Stations
  (CHIRPS) and Climate Hazards Center Infrared Temperature with Stations (CHIRTS), Climate Hazards
  Center, University of California Santa Barbara, <https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data>. The SPEI-12
  forcing and the P/PET aridity index were derived from these products for this study on a
  1991–2020 reference period and are included in the Zenodo archive.
- **Evapotranspiration.** MODIS MOD16A2GF version 061 gap-filled 8-day actual evapotranspiration
  at ~500 m, NASA Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center,
  <https://doi.org/10.5067/MODIS/MOD16A2GF.061>.
- **Land cover.** MapBiomas Chile Collection 2, annual 30 m land-cover and land-use
  classification, <https://chile.mapbiomas.org>.
- **Streamflow.** Daily mean streamflow for 811 DGA gauges (dataset `cr2_qflxDaily_2020`, February
  1913 to March 2020), compiled by the Center for Climate and Resilience Research (CR2),
  <https://www.cr2.cl>.
- **Snow water equivalent.** ERA5-Land monthly averaged reanalysis, snow depth water equivalent
  (variable `sd`) at 0.1°, Copernicus Climate Change Service Climate Data Store, catalogue entry
  `reanalysis-era5-land-monthly-means`, documented by @munozsabater_era5land_2021.
- **Elevation.** SRTM 3 arc-second (~90 m) void-filled digital elevation model, CGIAR-CSI SRTM 90 m
  Digital Elevation Database, <https://srtm.csi.cgiar.org>.
- **Climate classification.** Köppen-Geiger classes for the 1991–2020 normal period at ~1 km
  [@beck_high_2023].
- **River network.** HydroRIVERS version 1.0, used for the routed-topology validation of gauge
  classification, HydroSHEDS, <https://www.hydrosheds.org/products/hydrorivers>.
- **Orchard cadastre.** Catastro Frutícola, Centro de Información de Recursos Naturales (CIREN) and
  Oficina de Estudios y Políticas Agrarias (ODEPA), <https://www.odepa.gob.cl>.
- **Reservoirs, watersheds, water rights, and wells.** Reservoir storage records, the national dam
  registry (`Embalse_2026_05_31`), the Banco Nacional de Aguas cuenca and subcuenca hydrographic
  boundaries, the consumptive water-rights registry, and well hydrographs, all from the Dirección
  General de Aguas, Ministerio de Obras Públicas, Chile, <https://dga.mop.gob.cl>.
